summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet and blocked for SearchWoot public launch. Fleet-doctor, operations sweeps, site security checks, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, dependency provenance, release controls, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness are unavailable or unknown. This is a material evidence gap, not proof of compromise. Ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally; public exposure or security-sensitive release changes require the missing controls to be evidenced.

SearchWoot security decision: blocked for public beta or full launch. The launch checklist explicitly records incomplete access, secret, isolation, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, disclosure, accuracy, measurement, and upstream-rights evidence. Keep private and permit only bounded read-only evidence work.

items.title: Capture fleet security control evidence
items.summary: Produce a read-only, metadata-only security control matrix covering access boundaries, secrets exposure, isolation, provenance, release controls, rollback, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Preserve unknowns.
items.requested_action: Run authorized evidence capture only. Do not retrieve credentials, access private shells, exploit targets, or modify production.

items.title: Maintain SearchWoot private security gate
items.summary: Keep the private preview unchanged while source rights, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete.
items.requested_action: Permit only bounded read-only evidence work. Do not expose publicly, change credentials or configuration, expand notifications, deploy, spend, or send outreach.
